en:
If you truly wish to speak with Rantaro,
I shall prepare a seance at once.

There are a few that would suit our needs.
Hmm...which, I wonder, would be best...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kiyo for a while?
Do you have an interest in seances?

Kehehe...
Let me tell you all about them, then.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo spent some time teaching
me about seances...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I grew a little closer today.
